Good to plan

Feeding students well, on a student budget.

Student events usually mean big appetites and a fixed budget. Rice dishes, curries and grills feed a crowd better than lots of finger food, and a vegetarian main makes sure everyone eats. Plan for walk-ins: free food at a campus event draws more people than the sign-up list.

Check your campus rules on outside catering and where food can be served, and book early for orientation weeks and graduation season, which are busy.

Students living in Academic City or Silicon Oasis can also get daily meals delivered: see student meal plans in Dubai.

Questions

Good to know.

Do you cater university events in Dubai Academic City?

Yes. We cater orientation days, society events, career fairs and campus functions, including in Dubai Academic City and Silicon Oasis.

Can you cater a society iftar?

Yes. Tell us your headcount and the time of Maghrib at your campus, and we will plan delivery before iftar.

Do you cater graduation parties?

Yes. We cater graduation celebrations for graduates and their families, on campus where allowed or at home.

How should we plan for walk-ins?

Free food draws extra people, so add a buffer above your sign-up number. We can help you size it.

Is your food halal?

Yes. All our catering menus are 100% halal.
